content:
isabel: opened a small PR to add an on‑prem firewall + HSM appendix for Private/VPC docs. Includes an nftables example, an iptables-legacy note, systemd drop-in for kms-proxy, cert bundle one-liner, and tiny Go/Python SDK socket examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1678

noah: quick skim  looks great. two asks: 1) show both common PKCS#11 socket paths (/var/run/hsm/pkcs11.sock and /var/lib/hsm/pkcs11.sock) and an ACL example; 2) add an explicit note about concatenating cert chain order (root -> intermediate -> client).

jun: added the ACL example and nftables rule. I referenced the diagram at ../assets/diagrams/onprem-firewall.svg and updated the alt text to "On‑prem firewall and KMS/HSM topology". nft example included:
```bash
# nftables example
nft add rule inet filter input tcp dport 443 accept
```
and iptables fallback note: "If running iptables-legacy, use iptables -A INPUT -p tcp --dport 443 -j ACCEPT". Also added: `sudo setfacl -m u:kms:rw /var/run/hsm/pkcs11.sock`.

isabel: nice. for systemd please prefer a drop-in snippet rather than replacing the unit. can you paste that?

jun: drop-in snippet added:```ini
# /etc/systemd/system/kms-proxy.service.d/10-local.conf
[Service]
Environment=KMS_CONFIG=/etc/redwood/kms-proxy.yaml
Restart=on-failure
LimitNOFILE=65536
User=kms
```
and troubleshooting note: `journalctl -u kms-proxy -f` and `ss -xl | grep pkcs11`. Also a SELinux tip: use `semanage fcontext` to label socket and `restorecon`.

noah: SDK nit: Go example shouldn't use InsecureSkipVerify. show TLS creds and env var example instead. Python should use pathlib for unix sockets. Suggested snippets to include:
```go
creds := credentials.NewTLS(&tls.Config{InsecureSkipVerify: false})
conn, err := grpc.Dial(os.Getenv("KMS_ENDPOINT"), grpc.WithTransportCredentials(creds))
```
```py
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('/var/run/hsm/pkcs11.sock')
client = KMSClient(endpoint=f'unix://{path.as_posix()}')
```
Recommend env examples: `export KMS_ENDPOINT=unix:///var/run/hsm/pkcs11.sock` or `export KMS_ENDPOINT=tls://kms.example:443`.

infra-bot: docs-lint: link-check OK, broken-anchor 0, spelling warnings: 1 ("priviledged" -> "privileged"). CI preview: https://deploy-preview-1678--docs.redwood.ai/onprem-firewall-hsm

isabel: thanks all  I'll merge once one more approval lands and the spelling warning is fixed. noah, can you give a final ack on the snippets?

noah: lgtm after the InsecureSkipVerify change and pathlib usage.

isabel: merging in ~10m unless anyone objects. thanks everyone :shipit:
